title: Bar, steady heat conduction
description: Steel bar 100 x 20 x 10 mm, end x = 0 at 100 °C, end x = 100 at 20 °C, all other faces insulated.

quantities.label: Temperature near x = 25 (error relative to the 80 K span)
quantities.formula: T(x) = T_hot - (T_hot - T_cold) x / L, at the x of the probe's node
quantities.citation: Incropera et al., Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer (1D plane wall, Fourier's law), edition/section to be checked
quantities.tolerance_reason: A linear temperature field is exact for tetrahedra; the band covers solver precision.
